purpose: adjudicate the current public ETH and SOL liquid-staking yield as a market-direction-independent overlay only on identical native-token inventory already held idle for independent reasons

public_current_snapshot.displayed_rate_rule: APR is variable and estimated in cryptocurrency rather than a guaranteed fiat return

blocking_evidence: same-account current stakeable and redeemable state minimum maximum quota commission fee conversion ratio and redemption period
exact owned idle ETH or SOL balance not needed for orders collateral withdrawal settlement or prompt liquidity
owned subscription conversion reward and redemption lineage
all conversion spread slippage delay liquidity custody tax support and alternative-yield costs
proof that displayed principal protection covers the exact admitted product and does not eliminate receipt-token conversion redemption or venue risk

economic_gate.accepted_scope_if_proved: incremental native-token yield only on identical ETH or SOL already held idle for independent reasons when exact liquid-staking net value strictly exceeds every available same-account alternative
economic_gate.strict_positive_gate: every admitted interval and the aggregate must remain strictly positive in the native principal unit after all costs
economic_gate.volatile_asset_rule: do not buy retain or directionally hedge ETH or SOL solely for this yield; any hedge is a separate strategy with full funding basis margin liquidation and execution costs

distinctness.from_Soft_Staking: subscription converts native inventory into a liquid staking receipt token and advertises materially higher staking APR rather than automatic yield on an unchanged Spot balance
distinctness.from_conversion_parity: this candidate values native-token reward accrual on independently idle inventory and does not assume or trade an LST market discount
distinctness.from_delta_neutral_funding_stack: this candidate has no short perpetual leg and makes no claim about fiat-denominated return

signed_read_only_retry_contract.trigger: both designated ephemeral Binance mainnet credentials are available with explicit GET-only account-evidence authority
signed_read_only_retry_contract.permitted_scope: one frozen ETH and SOL staking quota conversion-rate reward and operation-history prequalification using endpoints already classified signed read-only by the official developer contract
signed_read_only_retry_contract.stop_condition: stop before staking redemption transfer trade order borrow or any account mutation
